import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static int K;
    static int MAXK;
    static int MAXD;
    static class Result {
        int[][] matrix;
        int[] inside;
        boolean[] exist;

        Result() {
            matrix = new int[MAXK][MAXK];
            inside = new int[MAXK];
            exist = new boolean[MAXK];
        }

        Result(Result other, int rot) {
            this();
            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
                exist[(i + rot) % K] = other.exist[i];
                inside[(i + rot) % K] = other.inside[i];
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    matrix[(i + rot) % K][(j + rot) % K] = other.matrix[i][j];
                }
            }
        }

        Result(Result a, Result b) {
            this();
            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
                exist[i] = a.exist[i] || b.exist[i];
                inside[i] = a.inside[i];
                if (!a.exist[i]) inside[i] = (int)((inside[i] + (long)b.inside[i]) % MOD);
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    inside[i] = (int)((inside[i] + (long)a.matrix[i][j] * b.inside[j]) % MOD);
                    matrix[i][j] = 0;
                    if (!b.exist[j]) matrix[i][j] = a.matrix[i][j];
                    if (!a.exist[i]) matrix[i][j] = (int)((matrix[i][j] + (long)b.matrix[i][j]) % MOD);
                    for (int m = 0; m < K; m++) {
                        matrix[i][j] = (int)((matrix[i][j] + (long)a.matrix[i][m] * b.matrix[m][j]) % MOD);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static Result[] pk;
    static int[] digits;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextInt();

        // Set maximum sizes based on problem constraints
        MAXD = 20; // assuming maximum number of digits
        MAXK = 50; // assuming maximum K value

        digits = new int[MAXD];
        pk = new Result[MAXD];

        int dcount = 0;
        for (long x = n; x > 0; x /= K) {
            digits[dcount++] = (int)(x % K);
        }

        // Initialize pk[0]
        pk[0] = new Result();
        pk[0].exist[0] = true;
        pk[0].inside[0] = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
            pk[0].matrix[0][j] = 1;
        }

        for (int p = 1; p < dcount; p++) {
            pk[p] = new Result(pk[p - 1], 0); // copy previous
            for (int v = 1; v < K; v++) {
                pk[p] = new Result(pk[p], new Result(pk[p - 1], v));
            }
        }

        Result res = new Result();
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = dcount - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int v = 0; v < digits[i]; v++) {
                res = new Result(res, new Result(pk[i], (sum + v) % K));
            }
            sum += digits[i];
        }

        long total = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            total = (total + res.inside[i]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }
}
